translation.name: Minor Magic Shield
profile: Minor Magic Shield offers brief protection to the caster or an ally they can see. It suits a moment when the party expects an imminent attack and wants to support a threatened member. Its effect is small but specific; it does not guarantee complete safety or create a lasting layer of defense for the entire adventure.

Timing matters, because the protection ends after the next attack against the target or after a short time. Casting makes sense alongside a clear plan for who needs protection right now. The bonuses do not stack with another magical bonus to the same defense, so existing effects must be considered rather than automatically layering them.

Exact effect: The target gains +1 to both PDEF and MDEF against the next attack. Target: caster or 1 ally within sight. Duration: until the next attack against the target, at most 1 round. Restrictions: twice per combat; does not stack with another magical bonus to the same defense. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

Target, duration, restrictions, and exact effect.
strings.Min. CH a Min. Level pouze dovolují kouz: Min. INT and Min. Level only allow a spell to be learned. The character must actually acquire it through leveling, a teacher, a book, a scroll, a reward, a discovery, or the story.
strings.Vytvoří neškodné světlo o dosahu přibliž: Creates harmless light with a range of about 5 m. The caster can turn it off at any time.
strings.bod nebo předmět na dosah: a point or object within reach
strings.Zapálí malý připravený zdroj ohně. Nezpů: Ignites a small, prepared source of fire. Deals no damage and cannot ignite wet material.
strings.nelze cílit na tvora ani nesený předmět: cannot target a creature or a carried item
strings.svíčka, pochodeň nebo suchý troud na doh: a candle, torch, or dry tinder within sight
strings.Vytvoří jednoduchý zvuk dlouhý nejvýše 6: Creates a simple sound lasting no more than 6 seconds. Cannot imitate the intelligible speech of a specific person.
strings.Odstraní běžnou špínu, bláto, prach nebo: Removes ordinary dirt, mud, dust, or odors without damaging the item.
strings.neodstraňuje jed, kletbu ani poškození: does not remove poison, curses, or damage
strings.předmět nebo plocha do 1 m²: an item or an area of up to 1 m²
strings.Ukáže směr k nejbližšímu dosažitelnému z: Shows the direction of the nearest reachable water source within 1 km. Does not determine whether the water is safe to drink.
strings.1 ruka; bez útoku a složité jemné práce: 1 hand; no attacks or complex fine work
strings.Vytvoří viditelnou magickou ruku, která: Creates a visible magical hand that can lift, carry, or set down an item, or press a simple mechanism. This is not Telekinesis and cannot affect a creature.
strings.volný předmět do 2 kg a 5 m: an unattached item up to 2 kg within 5 m
strings.1 nemagický předmět do velikosti batohu: 1 nonmagical item no larger than a backpack
strings.1× na stejné poškození; musí být přítomn: once per instance of damage; all parts must be present
strings.Spojí prasklinu, přetržený řemínek nebo: Mends a crack, a broken strap, or a small broken component. Does not restore consumed contents or magic.
strings.1 předmět, tvor nebo prostor do 5 m: 1 item, creature, or area within 5 m
strings.Odhalí přítomnost magie a její nejbližší: Detects the presence of magic and its closest school. Does not reveal its exact effect, trigger, or how to dispel it.
strings.Provede zkoušku CH proti 7/9/11 podle kv: Makes an INT check against 7/9/11 depending on the lock's quality. Success opens the lock; it does not dispel a magical lock or disarm a trap.
strings.2× za souboj; nesčítá se s jiným magický: twice per combat; does not stack with another magical bonus to the same defense
strings.Cíl získá +1 k FO i MO proti jednomu pří: The target gains +1 to both PDEF and MDEF against the next attack.
strings.do příštího útoku proti cíli, nejdéle 1: until the next attack against the target, at most 1 round
